spans.s: गण् vt. 10U (pp. गणित) 1. To count, to number, to enumerate, लीलाकमलपत्राणि गणयामास पार्वती K.S.vi.84, गणयति Git.G.ii.; 2. to class with or among; 3. to sum up, to add up; 4. to calculate, to compute; 5. to take into account, to give consideration to; 6. to estimate, to value at; 7. to consider, to regard as, to think to be, to take to be, किसलयतल्पं गणयति विहितहुताशविकल्पम् Git.G.iv., जातस्तु गण्यते सोऽत्र यः स्फुरेच्च श्रियाधिकः Panch.i., R.viii.69, xi.75, v.20; 8. to ascribe to, to attribute to, (with a loc.), जाड्यं ह्रीमति गण्यते Bhartr.ii.54; 9. to attend to, to take notice of, प्रणयमगणयित्वा यन्ममापद्गतस्य Vikr.iv.; 10. to care for, (generally with a negative particle) न हि गणयति ख्शुद्रो जंतुः परिग्रहफल्गुताम् Bhartr.ii.9, Sant.S.i.10, Bt.ii.53, xv.5, 45.With अधि-, 1. to praise; 2. to enumerate.With अव-, to disregard.With परि-, 1. to count over; 2. to consider, to think, अपरिगणयन् Megh.i.5.With प्र-, to calculate.With वि-, 1. to number, Yaj.iii.104; 2. to consider, Megh.ii.46, R.i.87; 3. to disregard, किमपि विगणयंतो बुद्धिमंतः सहंते Panch.iii.

गण m. 1. A flock, a multitude, a troop, a collection, सूत्रे मणिगणा इव Bg.vii.7; 2. a series, a class; 3. a body of followers or attendants; 4. a troop of demigods considered as Śiva’s attendants under the special superintendence of Gaṇeśa, a demigod of this troop, शिवमगात्मजया च कृतेर्ष्यया सकलहं सगणं शुचिमानसम् Kir.v.13, K.S.iii.40, 71, Megh.i.33, 55; 5. any assemblage or society of men formed for the attainment of the same ends; 6. a sect (in philosophy or religion); 7. a detachment of an army consisting of 27 chariots, as many elephants, 81 horses and 135 foot (a small division of अक्षौहिणी); 8. a number (in math.); 9. a foot (in prosody); 10. a series of roots or words belonging to the same rule and called after the first word of the series (in gram.), e.g. अदादिगण, i.e. the class of roots which begin with अद्; 11. an epithet of Gaṇeśa.
गण-अग्रणी m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
गण-अचल m. a name of the mountain Kailāsa as the residence of the Gaṇas of Śiva.
गण-अधिप, -अधिपति m. 1. a name of Śiva, Sis.ix.27; 2. of Gaṇeśa; 3. the chief of a troop of soldiers or of a class of disciples.
गण-अधिप, -अधिपति m. 1. a name of Śiva, Sis.ix.27; 2. of Gaṇeśa; 3. the chief of a troop of soldiers or of a class of disciples.
गण-अन्न n. a mess prepared for a number of persons in common, M.iv.209.
गणन n. 1. Reckoning, calculation; 2. adding, enumerating; 3. considering, supposing; 4. believing, regarding.
गणना f. See the preceding word, Megh.i.10, ii.24, Am.
गण-अभ्यंतर (I) a. one of a troop or number.
गण-अभ्यंतर (II) m. the leader of any religious association, R.iii.154.
गण-ईश m. a name of Gaṇapati, Śiva’s son, Yaj.i.271.
गाणेश m. A worshipper of Gaṇeśa.
गण-ईश˚जननी f. an epithet of Pārvatī.
गण-ईश˚भूषण n. red-lead.
गण-ईशान, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 2. of Śiva.
गण-ईशान, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 2. of Śiva.
गण-उत्साह m. the rhinoceros.
गण-कार m. 1. a classifier; 2. an epithet of Bhīmasena.
गण-कृत्वस् ind. for a whole series of times, for a number of times.
गण-गति f. a particular high number.
गण-चक्रक n. a dinner eaten in common by a party of virtuous men.
गण-च्छंदस् n. a metre measured by feet.
गण-तिथ f. forming a troop or assemblage.
गण-दीक्षा f. 1. Initiation of a number or a class; 2. performance of rites for a number of persons.
गण-देवता f. pl. troops of particular deities who generally appear in classes; (they are thus classified- आदित्य विश्वावसवस्तुषिता भास्वरानिलाः । महाराजिकसाध्याश्च रुद्राश्च गणदेवताः Am./i.1, 19).
गण-द्रव्य n. public property, common stock.
गण-धर m. 1. the head of a class or number; 2. the teacher of a school.
गण-नाथ, -नायक m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. of Gaṇeśa.
गण-नाथ, -नायक m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. of Gaṇeśa.
गण-नायिका f. an epithet of Durgā.
गण-प, -पति m. 1. a name of Gaṇeśa; 2. of Śiva.
गण-प, -पति m. 1. a name of Gaṇeśa; 2. of Śiva.
गाणपत a. (f. ती) 1. Relating to the leader of a troop; 2. relating to Gaṇeśa.
गण-पर्वत m. See गणाचल.
गण-पीठक n. the breast, the bosom.
गण-पुंगव (I) m. the head of a tribe or class.
गण-पुंगव (II) m. pl. the name of a country and its people.
गण-पूर्य m. the leader of a tribe or class.
गण-भर्तृ m. 1. an epithet of Śiva, गणभर्तुरुक्षा Kir.v.42; 2. of Gaṇeśa; 3. the leader of a class.
गण-भोजन m. eating in common.
गण-यज्ञ m. a rite common to all.
गण-राज्य n. name of an empire in the Dekkan.
गण-रात्र n. a series of nights.
गण-वृत्त n. See गणछंदस्.
गण-शस् ind. in troops, by classes.
गण-हास, -हासक m. a species of perfume.
गण-हास, -हासक m. a species of perfume.
गणक (I) a. (f. णिका) Bought for a large sum.
गणक (II) m. 1. An arithmetician; 2. an astrologer, e.g. वैयाकरणकिरातादपशब्दमृगाः क्व यांतु संत्रस्ताः । यदि नटगणकचिकित्सकवैतालिकवदनकंदरा न स्युः.
गणक (I) a. (f. णिका) Bought for a large sum.
गणिका f. 1. A harlot, a courtezan, गुणानुरक्ता गणिका च यस्य वसंतशोभेव वसंतसेना Mrich.i., निरकाशयद्रविमपेतवसुं वियदालयादपरदिग्गणिका Sis.ix.10; 2. a female elephant; 3. a kind of flower.
गणकी f. The wife of an astrologer.
गणना-गति f. the same as गणगति q.v.
गणना-पति m. an arithmetician.
गणना-महामात्र m. a minister of finance.
गणि f. Counting.
गणित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Numbered, counted, calculated; 2. regarded, cared for, (pp. of गण् q.v.).

गणित (II) n. 1. Reckoning, calculating; 2. the science of computation, mathematics, [comprising arithmetic (पाटीगणित or व्यक्तगणित), algebra (बीजगणित) and geometry (रेखागणित)], गणितमथकलां वैशिकीं हस्तिशिक्षां ज्ञात्वा Mrich.i.; 3. the sum of a progression; 4. a sum in general.
गणित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Numbered, counted, calculated; 2. regarded, cared for, (pp. of गण् q.v.).
गणितिन् m. 1. One who has made a calculation; 2. a mathematician.
गणिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Having a troop, e.g. श्वगणिन् ‘having a pack of hounds,’ R.ix.53.
गणिन् (II) m. A teacher.
गणिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Having a troop, e.g. श्वगणिन् ‘having a pack of hounds,’ R.ix.53.
गणेय a. (f. या) Numerable, what may be counted.
गणेय a. (f. या) Numerable, what may be counted.
गणेरु (I) m. The Karṇikāra tree.
गणेरु (II) f. 1. A harlot; 2. a female elephant.
गणेरुका f. a bawd, a procurers.
गाणपत a. (f. ती) 1. Relating to the leader of a troop; 2. relating to Gaṇeśa.
गाणपत्य (I) m. A worshiper of Gaṇeśa.
गाणपत्य (II) n. 1. Worship of Gaṇeśa; 2. the leadership of a troop.
गाणिक्य n. An assemblage of harlots.
